protocol.target: Next UTC-day log RV; 5-minute returns; fixed OLS, training-only Duan smearing.
factors: log(BTC volume yesterday / mean BTC volume over preceding 30 days, excluding yesterday)
negative 5-minute squared-return sum yesterday / yesterday RV
protocol.common_sample_start: 31 days after first full UTC day; all models share dates; features strictly before target day
protocol.inference: HAC 7 lags; sensitivity 1 and 30; Holm correction for two factor coefficients; joint robust Wald
protocol.bootstrap: 5000 circular moving-block samples of paired evaluation losses, blocks 7 and 30; fixed fitted forecasts, descriptive not nested-model p-values
protocol.sensitivity: 99% target/prior-day coverage subset; training Cook influence top 1% removal (diagnostic only); 10-minute RV target rerun
protocol.stationarity: ADF AIC and KPSS auto on training variables; inspect warnings, no automatic differencing
protocol.selection: No tuning from diagnostics or test. All three models reported. Annual splits descriptive.
protocol.limitations: 2026 already examined: retrospective. Upbit KRW local market. Conditional associations, not causal effects. RV measurement error; no new untouched test available.

quality.volume_missing_policy: Sum observed trades only; never forward-fill volume. Missing candles may be no-trade intervals or acquisition gaps; cannot distinguish from cached candles alone.
